title: Exhalation
author: Ted Chiang
summary: A collection of nine short stories about time, free will, artificial minds and what it means to be a person. Each story builds one clear idea and follows it carefully to its human consequences.
readIf: you like quiet, brainy science fiction that makes you think and sometimes ache.
skipIf: you want long plots or action, since these are slow, ideas-first stories.

pairings.reason: A tender story about an artificial being, with the same careful attention to what feeling means.
Classic science fiction that uses a strange world to examine human habits of thought.
A cerebral story of contact with something beyond human comprehension.
